_comment: Tier-2: DamHydroConditionLoadProcess is C++-only with undocumented defaults, and its default interval [0.0, 0.0] means it silently does nothing unless an interval containing TIME is passed. Pitfall (kratos.dam #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The process class resolves on DamApplication and not on core, and POSITIVE_FACE_PRESSURE — the variable it writes, named in the claim's required keys — is a CORE variable, not a Dam one. That split is why a reader assembling the parameter block reaches for the wrong module for the variable name. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
